method.generation_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: LAiDIES FG-WILLOW-LANE building-context card. Create a NEW, disjoint 3:2 landscape exterior illustration. IMAGE 1 is the mandatory FAMILY RENDERING authority: match its decisive black ink contours, hard-edged faceted/local-colour planes, flat adult editorial values, restrained halftone, crisp graphic-novel finish, and navy/electric-teal/hot-pink/coral palette with tiny gold accents. IMAGE 2 controls FAiRY IDENTITY ONLY if she appears: exact adult Black facial identity, curly updo, small star tiara, warm expression and silver wand; never inherit glossy fantasy rendering or plum robe. IMAGE 3 controls the exact HOUSE IDENTITY AND ARCHITECTURE: preserve the recognizable two-storey flat-roof silhouette, long upper storey with three windows, broad left picture window, recessed central pink star door, teal frames, low front steps and walkway, mature tree, garden planting and tall streetlamp. Translate that exact house into Image 1's ink/faceted rendering; do not copy Image 3's painterly finish, pale daytime palette, mailbox text or readable signs. Composition: environment first. The house and Willow Lane streetscape occupy at least 85% of the image. View from a slightly low three-quarter street angle at luminous late-1990s dusk, with deep navy sky, electric teal architectural shadows, coral/hot-pink door and sunset accents, restrained warm neutral walls, and small warm window lights. A tiny contextual FAiRY may stand near the doorway or on the path, under 12% of frame height, in navy/teal/coral tailoring holding the silver wand; she must not become a portrait. No desk, computer, paper, seated pose, or repeated interior composition. Keep the entire recognizable facade, front door, picture window, garden, path and streetlamp readable in a centered 390x260 crop. No mailbox lettering, house number, invented sign text, speech bubble, quote, UI, logo or mystery control. Rendering must be unequivocally 2D hand-inked adult editorial graphic novel: varied ink weight, angular colour facets, hard cel shadows, crisp building geometry, controlled halftone, no soft gradients or painterly texture. Avoid glossy fantasy, airbrush, 3D render, muddy/grungy building treatment, glamour cartoon, stickers, candy, purple/gold governing palette, white/cream page-shell look, illegible architecture, warped windows/steps, readable generated text, logos or watermark.
method.precise_edit_prompt: Edit only the most recently generated Willow Lane exterior image. Remove the small gold star-shaped wall plaque with the dark symbol/mark that appears immediately to the right of the pink front door. Replace that plaque area with the same uninterrupted warm-neutral faceted wall surface and matching inked shadow/texture. Preserve everything else exactly: identical house geometry, flat roof, all windows, pink star door, teal frames, steps, garden, tree, streetlamp, tiny FAiRY figure and wand, composition, 3:2 crop, lighting, navy/teal/hot-pink/coral palette, hard ink contours, faceted graphic-novel rendering, and full-resolution finish. Do not add any house number, sign, text, logo, symbol, plaque, mailbox lettering, UI, speech bubble, or other object.
